pending_interview.category: System design (ML/AI-specific) — RAG at scale, eval pipeline design, recommendation systems, agent platforms, feature store design
pending_interview.question: You are tasked with designing a feature store for a large e-commerce company. A feature store is a centralized system that computes, stores, and serves input variables (called "features") that machine learning models need both during training and at prediction time. The company has dozens of models in production — fraud detection, product recommendations, search ranking, and inventory forecasting — all with different latency requirements and data freshness needs. Walk through your design. How do you handle the difference between features that need to be computed in real time versus those that can be precomputed in batch? How do you ensure a model trained on historical features sees the same values at serving time? What happens when a feature's definition changes — how do you manage that without breaking live models?
